items.name: Quantum-Monte-Carlo-for-Exotic-Option-Pricing
items.description: This project explores Quantum Monte Carlo for pricing exotic options, using Quantum Amplitude Estimation to achieve a quadratic speedup over classical Monte Carlo methods. It includes Jupyter notebooks with Qiskit implementations, performance comparisons, and insights into quantum machine learning approaches like qGANs for financial modeling

items.name: crypto-lab-pq-rotation
items.description: Browser-based post-quantum migration planner for operational teams. Hybrid X.509 certs (ECDSA-P256 + ML-DSA-65), multi-jurisdiction regulatory timelines (CNSA 2.0, NIS, NCSC, BSI...), and a rolling key-rotation simulator with canary and rollback.

items.name: Sentinel
items.description: Sentinel is a smart layer that sits on top of a bank's existing systems and does the one thing the two teams never do: it looks at the security feed and the money feed at the same time, connects related clues, and produces a single, easy-to-read risk score for every transaction.

items.name: cryptodrishti
items.description: Enterprise cryptographic discovery and quantum-risk analysis — SIH26164. Seven sensors across source, dependencies, binaries, certificates, config and container images; purpose-aware migration targets; CycloneDX 1.6/1.7 CBOM validated offline against the official schema.

items.name: QUADRANT
items.description: Quantum Unimodular Arithmetic · Direction-Recorded Rotation for Amplitude-Native Tails. One shift-and-add ladder, run on a register that is in superposition. Every rotation is three shears. Every shear is a permutation. Every direction bit is kept, because it is the angle.

items.name: quantum-hndl-triage
items.description: A PyTorch model hit 100% training accuracy and missed all 207 CRITICAL assets - what happens when a risk class never appears in training. Grounded in the HKMA quantum-preparedness report.

items.name: Enterprise-Cryptographic-Discovery-Analysis-Tool-ECDAT-
items.description: Enterprise Cryptographic Discovery & Analysis Tool (ECDAT) automatically scans networks, applications, and cloud environments to inventory cryptographic assets. It identifies weak algorithms, misconfigurations, and key vulnerabilities, generating a Cryptographic Bill of Materials (CBOM) to support post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness.

items.name: crypto-lab-harvest-timeline
items.description: Browser-based Harvest-Now-Decrypt-Later risk simulator built around the Mosca Inequality (X+Y>Z). 20+ algorithms, 4 CRQC scenarios, 5 org profiles, and cost-of-delay projections using 2025 GRI expert estimates.
